svg.title: The traveller behind the notebook
svg.desc: Two original photographs of the traveller in a balanced side-by-side editorial spread. The first is a formal cream suit mirror portrait, the second is an outdoor travel portrait. Both photographs are shown without facial alteration.

g.text: AN OCCASION / A CHANGE OF PACE
A NEW STREET / A NEW STORY

svg.text: Two frames. A thousand things still to notice.
